name: rocket_mining_options
summary: What a rocket can collect, by the game's own mining formulas: its loadout, and per site the yield per cycle and hour, cycles to deplete, and what stops it. Lists 3 sites. Read only.

help.text: sites: the node 'to' and its discovered sites, else every charted node with a deposit. collectable and not_collectable list the sites by name; collectable_only keeps the first; when it keeps nothing, notes say why (no site, nothing on board that mines, or each site's kind and the machines' reasons).
help.keys: rocket_id, rocket_name, loadout {miners, collectors, scanners, cargo, gas_tank_litres, ...}, collectable, not_collectable, sites [{node, parent, kind, density, richness, size, survey_percent, depleted, ...}], count, notes.

loadout.text: Every Rocket Miner (on, its drill head: name, speed, ice_yield, ore_yield, health, power_factor, durability, expected_cycles_left, mines ice and ore, ice only or ore only; the miner's ore and ice speed factors; power while mining; hold_on_board), every Rocket Gas Collector (on, has_pipe_network), every Rocket Scanner (head_kind normal, surface or none, points and cycle, what it can do), cargo (holds, slots, filled, free), gas and liquid tank litres, and collects.

sites.text: kind (ore, ice or gas), density, richness, size, survey_percent (past 200 % yields x1.1, past 1,000 % x1.25), depleted, cycle_time_s (10 s at density 0 to 6 s at 10), base_units_per_cycle (round(baseline(size) x richness^1.6 x type factor), at least 1), stack_size, materials, machines (each miner and collector: collects, collected, units_per_cycle, cycle_s in whole 0.5 s ticks, units_per_hour, slots_per_hour, cycles_to_deplete, total_units_left, head_cycles_left, problems), collectable, units_per_hour, problems.

problems.text: An ice head at an ore site gives 0 ore while each cycle still depletes the site and wears the head. Miners skip gas sites. A collector gets something only at a gas site, and only equalises with its pipe: a pump must fill the tanks. No head, a worn head, the miner off, no cargo hold.

rocket_id.description: A rocket, its rocket network, or any part; left out when there is one rocket.

to.description: A node (name, map code or number, reference id): its deposit and discovered sites. Left out, every charted node with a deposit.

collectable_only.description: Only the sites this loadout collects at. Default false.
